svg.title: rEach and Teach: guardrail layers
svg.desc: Seven nested layers surround the AI agent: enrollment lock, signed rules, student consent, qualification, seal and witness ledger, shape check and slice fence. Beyond them, Teach runs hidden checks and grading on the server.
svg.text: Seven nested layers around the agent. The last word is not on the student's computer at all.
Every prompt is refused until the student enrolls on this computer. A copied install locks again.
No work until the instructors' rules are installed and their signature verifies. Offline grace: 24 hours.
Nothing is submitted without the student's yes, given within 30 minutes for exactly these files.
The agent must prove the slice first. Three failed tries raise a hand; the hard stop ends writes.
Each owned file carries an invisible seal and each session leaves a ledger. The server reads both.
Every change is checked against the course's Dovetail shape and the directive table.
Writes and commands land only inside the student's owned files. Keys, vault and git are off limits.
hidden checks and grading run on the server, out of the agent's reach
rEach stops accidents and casual tampering. It does not claim to stop a determined
machine owner, which is exactly why the grading happens on Teach.
